For that bound additionally retain the four targets' **exact line-30 cut frames**, the pinned centre-to-target cut incidences, and at least one zero-frame reader per centre. family.text: This family includes reassignments of the eight pure recovered inputs with unchanged inherited partner corrections. h1.text: 1. Keep the original recovery operations and inherited P-source helper paths. At each new handoff the lender is exactly its original R input. Replacing a helper changes its incoming independent dirty value to a chart of that input. Deleted early echo reads contain only that helper's incoming dirty value. Consequently these substitutions have zero P-source projection.

h2.text: 2. Apply the resulting additive target compensation at the beginning of A. Its additional source-dependent terms use only original R inputs. The target-to-target linear continuation from that boundary is unchanged. No continuation operation reads a target into a non-target. All target scales are nonzero and target ADDs have distinct endpoints.

h3.text: 3. The original P-source response in the uncompensated continuation is retained. Hypothesis 1 gives this by linearity and induction through the helper updates. It is also an explicit boundary condition, not an assumption that arbitrary changed source programs preserve that response.
